user.title: Custom Component Monitor
user.description: Set up Custom Component Monitor to track HACS-installed components in your Home Assistant installation.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration is allowed.

init.title: Custom Component Monitor options
init.description: Fine-tune what gets flagged as unused, and optionally let AI summarise and categorise your pending updates.

data.new_items_enabled: Show the "New in HACS" review card
data.auto_hide_foreign: Hide new items made for another country

data_description.exclude: Components that are actually in use but get flagged as unused. Pick from the currently-unused list, or type a name or domain for anything else.
data_description.ai_categorization_enabled: Label each pending HACS update with categories and a one-line summary.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Choose an AI Task entity (Home Assistant 2025.7+) or a Conversation agent. If one doesn't work for your model, try the other.
data_description.new_items_enabled: Track newly-indexed HACS repositories you haven't installed yet, and show them on a dedicated review card.
data_description.auto_hide_foreign: Hide new items made for another country — e.g. a national postal service or a local utility — instead of showing them mixed in with everything else.
data_description.home_country: Your country code, e.g. AU. Used to tell apart new items made for your own country from ones made for somewhere else.
data_description.extra_home_terms: Extra words that mean "this is for my country" — one per line. Use this for anything the country code alone wouldn't catch (a state name, a local brand, a utility).
data_description.new_items_ai_budget_seconds: How long each sorting pass may spend talking to the AI before it pauses and picks up where it left off. Sorting repeats automatically until everything new has been sorted, so this paces the work rather than capping it — the number of items per pass tunes itself to how fast your AI answers.

scan_now.name: Custom Component Monitor: manual scan
scan_now.description: Trigger an immediate scan of all HACS-installed custom components.

update_and_action.name: Update and Add Action
update_and_action.description: Install the HACS update and add a to-do item to track follow-up actions.

entity_id.name: Update Entity
entity_id.description: The update entity to install (e.g. update.my_integration_update).

version.name: Version
version.description: Specific version to install. If omitted, installs the latest version.

update_all.name: Update all
update_all.description: Install every available HACS custom-component update at once (integrations, cards and themes that currently show an update).

create_actions.name: Create action items
create_actions.description: Also add a to-do item for each component (with release notes), the same as "Update & Action". Off by default — just installs.

entity_ids.name: Limit to entities
entity_ids.description: Only update these update entities. If omitted, every pending HACS update is installed.

generate_summaries.name: Generate AI summaries
generate_summaries.description: Generate the missing AI summaries and categories for pending HACS updates. Only updates that don't already have a summary are sent to the AI, unless "Force" is enabled.

entity_ids.name: Limit to entities
entity_ids.description: Only summarise these update entities. If omitted, every pending update that is missing a summary is processed.

force.name: Force
force.description: Regenerate even when a summary already exists, and ignore the retry backoff after previous failures. Costs one AI call per update.

max_items.name: Maximum updates
max_items.description: Stop after this many AI calls. Omit for no limit.

dismiss_new_items.name: Dismiss new HACS items
dismiss_new_items.description: Dismiss one or more items from the "New in HACS" review card. Give exactly one of repositories, category or all — it acts on whatever sensor.hacs_new_items is currently showing as new.

repositories.name: Repositories
repositories.description: Dismiss these repositories (owner/repo, e.g. "home-assistant/core"). Only ones currently shown as new are affected — anything else is ignored.

category.name: Category
category.description: Dismiss every currently-shown new item in this category.

restore_new_items.name: Restore new HACS items
restore_new_items.description: Bring back items previously dismissed or auto-hidden on the "New in HACS" review card. Give exactly one of repositories, category or all. An item restored from auto-hide is also marked "never hide again", so the country rule can't immediately hide it a second time.

repositories.name: Repositories
repositories.description: Restore these repositories (owner/repo). One that isn't currently dismissed or hidden is ignored.

category.name: Category
category.description: Restore every hidden or dismissed item in this category.

all.name: All
all.description: Restore every hidden and dismissed item.

categorise_new_items.name: Categorise new HACS items
categorise_new_items.description: Run AI categorisation for pending items on the "New in HACS" review card. You should not normally need this: sorting starts by itself after every scan and keeps going until the backlog is clear. Only items without a cached category are processed unless "Force" is enabled. Requires AI summaries to be enabled in the integration options.

max_items.name: Maximum items
max_items.description: Sort at most this many items and then stop for good — no background catch-up afterwards. Omit to sort the whole backlog.

max_seconds.name: Time limit
max_seconds.description: How long this one pass may spend on AI calls before handing the rest to the background catch-up. Omit to use the "AI sorting time per pass" option.

force.name: Force
force.description: Re-categorise even items that already have a cached AI category, ignoring the cache. Costs one AI call per item.
